title: Fox eating a snack
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Fox body -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="72" rx="28" ry="18" fill="#ff8c1a"/>
  <!-- Belly -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="78" rx="18" ry="10" fill="#ffe0b3"/>
  <!-- Head -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="48" rx="20" ry="17" fill="#ff8c1a"/>
  <!-- Left ear -->
  <polygon points="32,38 28,20 42,32" fill="#ff8c1a"/>
  <polygon points="34,36 31,24 40,32" fill="#ffd9a0"/>
  <!-- Right ear -->
  <polygon points="68,38 72,20 58,32" fill="#ff8c1a"/>
  <polygon points="66,36 69,24 60,32" fill="#ffd9a0"/>
  <!-- White face patch -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="54" rx="13" ry="10" fill="#ffe0b3"/>
  <!-- Eyes -->
  <circle cx="42" cy="45" r="3" fill="#5a2a00"/>
  <circle cx="58" cy="45" r="3" fill="#5a2a00"/>
  <circle cx="43" cy="44" r="1" fill="#ffffff"/>
  <circle cx="59" cy="44" r="1" fill="#ffffff"/>
  <!-- Nose -->
  <circle cx="50" cy="52" r="2.5" fill="#5a2a00"/>
  <!-- Happy mouth -->
  <path d="M46,56 Q50,60 54,56" stroke="#5a2a00" stroke-width="1.5" fill="none"/>
  <!-- Snack (cookie) being held -->
  <circle cx="50" cy="66" r="7" fill="#c97b3a"/>
  <circle cx="47" cy="64" r="1.2" fill="#6b3a10"/>
  <circle cx="53" cy="66" r="1.2" fill="#6b3a10"/>
  <circle cx="49" cy="69" r="1.2" fill="#6b3a10"/>
  <!-- Left paw holding snack -->
  <ellipse cx="42" cy="70" rx="6" ry="4" fill="#ff8c1a"/>
  <ellipse cx="42" cy="70" rx="4" ry="2.5" fill="#ffd9a0"/>
  <!-- Right paw holding snack -->
  <ellipse cx="58" cy="70" rx="6" ry="4" fill="#ff8c1a"/>
  <ellipse cx="58" cy="70" rx="4" ry="2.5" fill="#ffd9a0"/>
  <!-- Tail -->
  <path d="M22,78 Q8,68 10,54 Q12,44 22,48 Q16,58 26,70 Z" fill="#ff8c1a"/>
  <path d="M11,56 Q13,47 21,50 Q17,57 18,62 Z" fill="#ffe0b3"/>
  <!-- Front legs -->
  <rect x="36" y="84" width="7" height="10" rx="3" fill="#ff8c1a"/>
  <rect x="57" y="84" width="7" height="10" rx="3" fill="#ff8c1a"/>
</svg>
